welcome.purpose: Find the lowest honest price for your medicine, and see what help you may get.
welcome.languageHint: Changes the app's language right away
welcome.privacy: Your answers stay on this phone.
welcome.startHint: A few short questions about coverage, household and income
welcome.justSearchHint: Skips the questions and opens medicine search
welcome.changeLater: You can change the language anytime in Settings.

coverage.title: Do you have health insurance right now?
coverage.body: This includes Medi-Cal, Medicare, and plans from a job or Covered California.
coverage.noSub: I don't have a health plan
coverage.unsureSub: That's okay. We'll help you check.

coverageType.title: What kind?
coverageType.body: Pick the one that fits best.
coverageType.otherSub: We'll show you what to check

checklist.title: Your insurance checklist
checklist.body: Check off what you have. These help when you talk to your plan or your pharmacy.

items.card: Your member card and the member services phone number
items.formulary: Your plan's drug list and your medicine's tier
items.deductible: Your deductible, and how much of it you have paid this year
items.pharmacy: Your plan's preferred pharmacy or mail-order pharmacy

checklist.copayBody: Optional: what do you usually pay for this medicine with your insurance?
checklist.copayInvalid: Type an amount in dollars, like 25 or 12.50.
checklist.copayNote: Cash prices can be lower than a copay. But cash payments may not count toward your deductible — ask your plan.

mediCal.title: Using Medi-Cal for medicine
mediCal.body: Show your Medi-Cal card at the pharmacy. If a medicine is not covered, ask your doctor or pharmacist what to do.

county.title: Where do you live?
county.body: Some help depends on your county.
county.otherNote: Local help in this app is for {{region}}. You can still compare prices and use everything else.

age.title: Is anyone in your household 65 or older?
age.body: We ask only to show Medicare information.

household.title: How many people are in your household?

income.title: About how much does your household make?
income.body: Before taxes. Pick the range that fits.
income.unitLabel: Show amounts per month or per year
income.fplNote_one: Ranges use the {{year}} federal poverty guidelines for {{count}} person.
income.fplNote_other: Ranges use the {{year}} federal poverty guidelines for {{count}} people.
income.exactHint: Before taxes. It stays on this phone.
income.exactInvalid: Type an amount in dollars, like 2400.
income.nearLimitTitle: You're close to an income limit.
income.skipHint: Skips the estimate. Everything else still works.
income.noBrackets: We couldn't build income ranges for this household size. You can type your exact income instead.

result.title: Here's what may help
result.count_one: We found {{count}} option that may help.
result.count_other: We found {{count}} options that may help.
result.estimate: This is an estimate, not a decision.
result.limitUpTo_one: Up to {{max}} a year for {{count}} person
result.limitUpTo_other: Up to {{max}} a year for {{count}} people
result.nearLimitTitle: You're close to an income limit.
result.standardBody: We didn't find a program that may fit your answers. This is only an estimate. You can still compare prices for your medicine.
result.skippedBody: You chose not to share your income, so we can't estimate which programs may fit. Everything else in the app still works.
result.missingTitle: We need your income for an estimate
result.missingBody: Add your income to see which programs may fit. Everything else in the app still works.
result.startOverBody: This clears your answers and saved medicines on this phone.
result.announce_one: Your estimate is ready. {{count}} option may help.
result.announce_other: Your estimate is ready. {{count}} options may help.
